source_title: News Distribution defaults. Yahoo gives its specifications to partners it onboards.

fetch.note: A watch window News Distribution uses to say a fetch is later than usual. It is not a Yahoo schedule.

feed.format.note: News Distribution writes RSS 2.0 and the address works over HTTPS when the site does. Yahoo's feed specification was not read.

date.published.note: The publication date is written with a time zone and is never in the future. This is how News Distribution writes dates in RSS; Yahoo's own date rule was not read.

body.min_words.note: Articles under the minimum number of words are left out of this feed. 150 is a News Distribution default the person can change. Yahoo's real minimum is not published here; ask the Yahoo contact.

html.tags.note: The feed keeps common HTML (paragraphs, headings, links, lists, quotes, images) and removes scripts, frames and styles. Yahoo's own list of allowed tags was not read.

image.lead.note: The featured image comes first in the article body. Yahoo's own image rule was not read.

guid.stable.note: An updated article keeps its guid and its original publication date. Whether Yahoo reads an item the same way was not confirmed.

onboarding.required.note: Yahoo has to onboard the feed before it fetches it. This could not be confirmed from a public Yahoo source.

title.missing.note: An item without a title cannot be read, so the article is left out.

link.missing.note: An item without a public address cannot be read, so the article is left out.
